description: Life test data for a micro switch in railway vehicle is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Yuankun SUI. The test data of a micro switch. This is a set of micro switch data from the new to the complete failure. The micro switch is switched on and off repeatedly, and the voltage data of the micro switch is collected in real time by the data acquisition system. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
